description: Check registration availability for up to 200 domain names in a single call. Emulated bulk: the server runs single lookups concurrently in the API's fast mode, and each row carries the API's answer unchanged: AVAILABLE, UNAVAILABLE or UNDETERMINED. UNDETERMINED means the API could not decide; it is not a negative. Use this whenever you have 2 or more domains to check. For the slower, more accurate check of a few domains, use `domain_availability`. Do NOT use this to find out who owns a domain.

confirm.description: Pass true to run a call estimated at over 100 credits, once the user has agreed to that cost.

credits.description: Which credit balance the lookups are billed to. Defaults to DA (Domain Availability credits).

domain_names.description: Domain names to check (1 credit per domain, max 200 entries per call). Duplicates are looked up once.

name: bulk_domain_availability
